title: A site's own sign-in door gives an agent session only to a live seat (accepted, not declined or revoked), and the session carries the role's fixed toolsets so a viewer is read-only
steps: S1: From vendor/tracy/dsh-passwords run the command in `run.cmd`.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok: an invited, declined, revoked or status-less roster row signs nobody in; a live row decides the role; a live viewer gets a read-only sandbox with no upload, git, workspace creation or visitor cap; retired admin/developer roles sign in as editor.
fence: grantLaneSession takes only a roster row with status 'active' and a seat-book role, and passes toolsetsForRole(role) to upsertSeatUser; permissionsFor makes a seat with no content/code/site toolset read-only. Local gateway with a fake seat book, no network.

tests: T1: a seat whose status is invited gets NO lane session
T1: a seat whose status is declined gets NO lane session
T1: a seat whose status is revoked gets NO lane session
T1: a seat whose status is undefined gets NO lane session
T1: a declined row and a live row for one address: the LIVE row decides the role
T1: a live viewer seat signs in READ-ONLY
T1/ADR 0028: a retired role from an old seat book (admin, developer) signs in as an editor
S14: ANY seat holding no content/code/site toolset runs read-only
S14/ADR 0028: retired roles map to editor
